items.en: HUR: Russia keeps missile stocks steady at up to 700 ballistic and several thousand cruise missiles, produces 200+ missiles a month, and has ordered over 100,000 Geran-type drones and decoys for 2026
items.nl: HUR: Rusland houdt raketvoorraad stabiel op tot 700 ballistische en enkele duizenden kruisraketten, produceert ruim 200 raketten per maand en bestelde voor 2026 meer dan 100.000 Geran-drones en lokdrones
items.sEn: According to figures Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) gave the Ukrainian outlet NV, published on 20 October 2026 and reported by Euromaidan Press, Russia holds up to 700 ballistic missiles and several thousand cruise missiles in reserve, roughly the same level HUR reported in July despite the autumn mass strikes.…
items.sNl: Volgens cijfers die de Oekraïense militaire inlichtingendienst HUR aan het Oekraïense medium NV gaf, gepubliceerd op 20 oktober 2026 en overgenomen door Euromaidan Press, heeft Rusland tot 700 ballistische raketten en enkele duizenden kruisraketten in reserve, ongeveer hetzelfde niveau als HUR in juli meldde, ondanks…

items.en: Russia hits Kyiv with Iskander-M, S-400, Zircon and Oniks missiles and 210 drones, including cluster-armed Iskanders in the historic centre, hours after the Putin–Witkoff meeting; at least 9 killed across Ukraine
items.nl: Rusland valt Kyiv aan met Iskander-M-, S-400-, Zircon- en Oniks-raketten en 210 drones, onder meer Iskanders met clustergevechtskop in het historische centrum, uren na overleg Poetin–Witkoff; zeker 9 doden in heel Oekraïne
items.sEn: Russia launched a combined missile and drone attack on Ukraine from 18:00 on 21 October 2026 into the morning of 22 October, with Kyiv as the main target. According to Ukraine's Air Force, Russia fired Iskander-M ballistic missiles, S-400 missiles, Zircon and Oniks missiles from Kursk, Bryansk and Rostov oblasts, toge…

items.en: Russia fires 39 ballistic-trajectory missiles and 128 drones, 77 of them jet-powered, at Ukraine overnight on 13-14 October: three killed in Kyiv, power cut in five districts
items.nl: Rusland vuurt in de nacht van 13 op 14 oktober 39 raketten met ballistische baan en 128 drones (waarvan 77 straalaangedreven) af op Oekraïne: drie doden in Kyiv, stroom uitgevallen in vijf districten
items.sEn: Russia carried out a massed combined strike on Ukraine between 18:00 on 13 October and the morning of 14 October, according to the Ukrainian Air Force. It says its radio-technical troops tracked 167 air-attack assets. These were 39 missiles flying ballistic trajectories, listed as Iskander-M, KN-23, S-400, Zircon and…

items.en: Russia shows Pantsir-S1M on Belarusian MZKT-7930-312 chassis at Tsentr-2026, first official confirmation of the configuration
items.nl: Rusland toont Pantsir-S1M op Wit-Russisch MZKT-7930-312-chassis tijdens Tsentr-2026: eerste officiële bevestiging van de configuratie
items.sEn: During the strategic exercise Tsentr-2026, Russia showed an upgraded Pantsir-S1M gun-and-missile air defence system mounted on a Belarusian MZKT-7930-312 chassis, Defence Blog reports. It is the first official confirmation of this configuration, which until now was known only from a leaked supply contract and from one…

items.en: Russian combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, 29-30 Sep: Zircon/Oniks, Iskander and 188 drones, energy infrastructure the main target
items.nl: Russische gecombineerde aanval op Kyiv en oblast Kyiv, 29-30 sep: Zircon/Oniks, Iskander en 188 drones, energie-infrastructuur hoofddoel
items.sEn: According to Ukraine's Air Force, Russia attacked Ukraine on the night of 29-30 September (from 18:00 on 29 September) with Zircon/Oniks anti-ship missiles launched from Kursk Oblast, Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles launched from Voronezh and Bryansk oblasts, and 188 drones: Shahed (86 of them jet-powered), Gerber…

items.en: Night of 28-29 Sep: Russia strikes Ukraine with a Zircon, two ballistic missiles and 152 drones; Air Force claims 109 downed, two unexploded ballistic warheads defused in Kyiv
items.nl: Nacht van 28 op 29 sep: Rusland valt Oekraïne aan met een Zircon, twee ballistische raketten en 152 drones; luchtmacht claimt 109 neergehaald, twee niet-ontplofte ballistische gevechtskoppen in Kyiv onschadelijk gemaakt
items.sEn: Russia attacked Ukraine overnight on 28-29 September 2026 with one Zircon/Oniks anti-ship missile, two Iskander-M or S-400 ballistic missiles (launched from Kursk Oblast) and 152 drones, according to Ukraine's Air Force. The drones were Shahed types (82 of them jet-powered), Gerbera attack drones and Parodiya decoys,…

items.nl: Rusland hoopt 80-raketkruiser Admiraal Nachimov na bijna 30 jaar reparatie weer in dienst te nemen
